descriptionEn: An apartment or office is offered for rent in Lagjja Kodrina, Mati 1, Prishtina.

The space includes a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, one bathroom and a separate WC, a terrace with an open view, as well as a private garage for the convenience and security of the car.
The apartment/office is unfurnished and suitable for residential or professional use.
